title: Freshest First
description: When you're chasing down what just happened, the most recent event should be the first thing you see. Confirm the Audit Log table on the admin console actually renders newest-first, not just returns that order from the API.
successCondition: After two distinct logins (e.g. customer@swiftcargo.test then admin@swiftcargo.test) happen in that order, reloading the Admin console's Audit log card shows the admin@swiftcargo.test "auth.login" row rendered above (earlier in DOM order than) the customer@swiftcargo.test "auth.login" row.
hints: Log in as admin last, right before reloading /admin, so its timestamp is unambiguously the newest.
Assert on DOM order of the rendered rows, not just on the underlying array — a rendering bug could reverse them even if the API order is correct.
